searchText: We now shape TCREATE as CREATE2. I could imagine that executing different code from same account could make sense. (so CREATE usage instead of CREATE2 usage). I guess this is still possible by having initcode fetch runtime code from a helper contract 🤔 So we would for instance use TSTORE to save runtime bytecode, or point to a different TCREATE contract Do we allow CREATE inside TCREATE contracts? What about nonce housekeeping? Also <@1361003005691822160> see https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12359/changes 😄
